title: PowerShell Profile Settings
description: Configuration for the PowerShell profile, read from the settings.json next to profile.ps1.

DefaultCulture.description: Culture applied to the session via [CultureInfo]::CurrentCulture. Use a culture name such as en-US, or an empty string for the invariant culture.

DefaultEncoding.description: Default -Encoding applied to Cmdlets via $PSDefaultParameterValues. Accepts the values supported by PowerShell 7.1 and higher.

DotSourceDirectory.description: Directory whose *.ps1 scripts are dot-sourced on profile launch. A warning is emitted when the path does not exist.

EnableClassicProgressbar.description: Use the classic progress bar view with a cyan background and yellow text instead of the default minimal view.

Modules.description: PowerShell module names to import on profile launch. A warning is emitted for any module that is not installed.

Prompt.description: Toggles for optional segments of the command prompt.

EnableBatteryStatus.description: Display the remaining battery charge while running on battery power.

EnableBranchUserName.description: Display the active Git user name next to the branch name.

EnableTimestamp.description: Display the current wall-clock time (HH:mm:ss) next to the elapsed execution time.
